facts: Distance-sale goods generally carry a 14-day withdrawal right, subject to exceptions.
Since 19 June 2026, applicable online distance contracts require an easy-to-find online withdrawal function and durable-medium acknowledgement.
Pre-contract information must disclose withdrawal procedure and relevant seller/price/shipping information.
Online customers generally have 14 days after receipt to tell the seller they want to cancel, then another 14 days to return.
Refund is generally due within 14 days after goods are returned.
Goods should be delivered within 30 days unless another period was agreed.
Seller needs a reasonable basis for any stated shipping time.
If no shipping time is stated, the seller generally needs a reasonable basis to ship within 30 days.
If shipment cannot be made on time, customer consent to delay or prompt cancellation/refund rules apply.

source_baselines.source: Israel Consumer Protection and Fair Trade Authority / Knesset
facts: Distance-sale cancellation rights generally include a 14-day period for goods, with category/exemption details requiring legal review.
Remote-sale disclosure must include business identity, core product/service terms, price/payment terms and cancellation method.
Online businesses must provide a clear, prominent online cancellation route where the transaction can be concluded online.
Australian Consumer Law consumer guarantees cannot be excluded by store policy.
Major product problems may entitle the consumer to choose refund or replacement.
There is no general statutory change-of-mind remedy under consumer guarantees; any voluntary change-of-mind policy must be honored.
